"""Typed input models and compilation for the offline H3Act pipeline."""
from __future__ import annotations

import keyword
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, List, Optional, Tuple

from modules.byte_program import Context, MAX, size

NAME_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}\Z", re.ASCII)
SEED_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,64}\Z", re.ASCII)
DEF_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,31}\Z", re.ASCII)
TOKEN_BYTES_RE = re.compile(rb"[!#$%&'*+.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z-]+\Z")
TOKEN_TEXT_RE = re.compile(r"[!#$%&'*+.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z-]+\Z", re.ASCII)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class FrameSpec:
    kind: str
    value: Any = None       # list[(Node,Node)] for headers, Node otherwise
    end: bool = False
    time: int = 0           # sleep duration in milliseconds


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CaseSpec:
    name: str
    frames: List[FrameSpec]
    method: bytes
    target: bytes
    host: bytes             # exact expected host bytes (not lower-cased)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class EventSpec:
    at: int
    kind: str
    stream: Optional[int] = None
    fields: Optional[List[Tuple[Any, Any]]] = None
    data: Any = None
    end: bool = False


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PartSpec:
    owner: Optional[str]
    data: Any


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ChannelSpec:
    name: str
    parts: List[PartSpec]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class DocumentSpec:
    seed: str
    timeout_ms: int
    cases: List[CaseSpec]
    events: List[EventSpec]
    channels: List[ChannelSpec]
    contexts: Any = None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Primitive validation


def exact(obj, keys):
    if type(obj) is not dict or set(obj) != set(keys):
        raise ValueError("object keys")


def exact_allowed(obj, required, allowed):
    if type(obj) is not dict:
        raise ValueError("object type")
    if not required <= set(obj) or not set(obj) <= allowed:
        raise ValueError("object keys")


def integer(value, minimum=0, maximum=MAX):
    if type(value) is not int or not minimum <= value <= maximum:
        raise ValueError("integer")
    return value


def boolean(value):
    if type(value) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("boolean")
    return value


def sequence(value, maximum):
    if type(value) is not list or len(value) > maximum:
        raise ValueError("array")
    return value


def text(value, maximum=65536):
    if type(value) is not str or len(value) > maximum:
        raise ValueError("string")
    try:
        value.encode("utf8")
    except UnicodeEncodeError as exc:
        raise ValueError("string encoding") from exc
    return value


def _ascii(value, maximum=8192):
    text(value, 65536)
    try:
        encoded = value.encode("ascii")
    except UnicodeEncodeError as exc:
        raise ValueError("ascii") from exc
    if len(encoded) > maximum:
        raise ValueError("ascii length")
    return encoded


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compilation


def _compile_headers(context, frame, case_index, frame_index, fields_count):
    has_mapping = "headers_kv" in frame
    has_pairs = "data_to_transfered" in frame
    if has_mapping == has_pairs:
        raise ValueError("exactly one header representation")
    end = frame.get("End_Stream", False)
    boolean(end)

    pairs = []
    if has_mapping:
        exact_allowed(frame, {"Type", "headers_kv"},
                      {"Type", "headers_kv", "End_Stream"})
        mapping = frame["headers_kv"]
        if type(mapping) is not dict:
            raise ValueError("header mapping")
        if len(mapping) > 128:
            raise ValueError("header block size")
        for pair_index, (name_source, value_source) in enumerate(mapping.items()):
            text(name_source, 65536)
            text(value_source, 65536)
            name = context.template(
                name_source,
                f"case/{case_index}/frame/{frame_index}/h/{pair_index}/n")
            value = context.template(
                value_source,
                f"case/{case_index}/frame/{frame_index}/h/{pair_index}/v")
            pairs.append((name, value))
        fields_count += len(mapping)
    else:
        exact_allowed(frame, {"Type", "data_to_transfered"},
                      {"Type", "data_to_transfered", "End_Stream"})
        raw_pairs = sequence(frame["data_to_transfered"], 128)
        for pair_index, pair in enumerate(raw_pairs):
            sequence(pair, 2)
            if len(pair) != 2:
                raise ValueError("header pair")
            name_source, value_source = pair
            text(name_source, 65536)
            text(value_source, 65536)
            name = context.template(
                name_source,
                f"case/{case_index}/frame/{frame_index}/h/{pair_index}/n")
            value = context.template(
                value_source,
                f"case/{case_index}/frame/{frame_index}/h/{pair_index}/v")
            pairs.append((name, value))
        fields_count += len(raw_pairs)

    return FrameSpec("headers", pairs, end, 0), fields_count


def _compile_frame(context, frame, case_index, frame_index, fields_count,
                   pause_sum):
    if type(frame) is not dict:
        raise ValueError("frame")
    kind = frame.get("Type")
    if kind not in ("headers", "data", "datagram", "sleep"):
        raise ValueError("frame type")

    if kind == "sleep":
        exact(frame, {"Type", "Time_to_Stop"})
        duration = integer(frame["Time_to_Stop"], 0, MAX)
        pause_sum += duration
        if pause_sum > MAX:
            raise ValueError("pause budget")
        return FrameSpec("sleep", None, False, duration), fields_count, pause_sum

    if kind == "headers":
        compiled, fields_count = _compile_headers(
            context, frame, case_index, frame_index, fields_count)
        return compiled, fields_count, pause_sum

    exact_allowed(frame, {"Type", "data_to_transfered"},
                  {"Type", "data_to_transfered", "End_Stream"})
    end = frame.get("End_Stream", True)
    boolean(end)
    source = text(frame["data_to_transfered"], 65536)
    data = context.template(
        source, f"case/{case_index}/frame/{frame_index}/data")
    return FrameSpec(kind, data, end, 0), fields_count, pause_sum


def compile_cases(cases, context):
    """Compile an already root-validated case array into typed case specs."""
    names = set()
    compiled_cases = []
    field_pairs = 0
    frame_budget = 0
    timeout_placeholder = MAX
    for case_index, case in enumerate(cases):
        exact(case, {"name", "frames", "expect"})
        name = text(case["name"], 32)
        if NAME_RE.fullmatch(name) is None or name in names:
            raise ValueError("case name")
        names.add(name)

        raw_frames = sequence(case["frames"], 50000)
        frame_budget += len(raw_frames)
        pause_sum = 0
        frames = []
        for frame_index, raw_frame in enumerate(raw_frames):
            frame, field_pairs, pause_sum = _compile_frame(
                context, raw_frame, case_index, frame_index, field_pairs,
                pause_sum)
            frames.append(frame)

        expect = case["expect"]
        exact(expect, {"method", "target", "host"})
        expected = {}
        for key in ("method", "target", "host"):
            encoded = _ascii(expect[key], 8192)
            if not encoded or any(value < 33 or value > 126 for value in encoded):
                raise ValueError("expected identity")
            expected[key] = encoded
        if TOKEN_BYTES_RE.fullmatch(expected["method"]) is None:
            raise ValueError("expected method")

        # The caller replaces this conservative value with the real timeout
        # when checking the final sum.
        compiled_cases.append(CaseSpec(
            name=name, frames=frames, method=expected["method"],
            target=expected["target"], host=expected["host"]))
    return compiled_cases, frame_budget, field_pairs


def compile_document(document):
    """Validate the complete JSON document and compile all templates."""
    exact(document, {"seed", "definitions", "timeout_ms", "cases", "events",
                     "channels"})

    seed = text(document["seed"], 64)
    if SEED_RE.fullmatch(seed) is None:
        raise ValueError("seed")

    raw_definitions = sequence(document["definitions"], 8192)
    for row in raw_definitions:
        if type(row) is not list or len(row) != 2:
            raise ValueError("definition pair")
        text(row[0], 32)
        text(row[1], 8192)
    # Context performs the precise identifier, keyword, AST-depth and
    # expression-semantics checks in definition order.
    context = Context(raw_definitions, seed)

    timeout_ms = integer(document["timeout_ms"], 1, 10 ** 9)

    raw_cases = sequence(document["cases"], 2000)
    cases, frame_budget, field_pairs = compile_cases(raw_cases, context)
    if frame_budget > 50000:
        raise ValueError("combined budget")

    # Validate the per-case pause + timeout budgets after compilation.
    for raw_case, case in zip(raw_cases, cases):
        pause_sum = sum(frame.time for frame in case.frames
                        if frame.kind == "sleep")
        if pause_sum + timeout_ms > MAX:
            raise ValueError("time budget")

    raw_events = sequence(document["events"], 50000)
    if frame_budget + len(raw_events) > 50000:
        raise ValueError("combined budget")
    events = []
    for event_index, record in enumerate(raw_events):
        if type(record) is not dict:
            raise ValueError("event")
        kind = record.get("kind")
        if kind not in ("close", "headers", "data"):
            raise ValueError("event kind")

        if kind == "close":
            exact(record, {"at", "kind"})
            at = integer(record["at"], 0, MAX)
            events.append(EventSpec(at=at, kind="close"))
            continue

        exact(record, {"at", "kind", "stream", "end",
                       "fields" if kind == "headers" else "data"})
        at = integer(record["at"], 0, MAX)
        stream = integer(record["stream"], 0, (1 << 32) - 1)
        end = boolean(record["end"])

        if kind == "headers":
            raw_fields = sequence(record["fields"], 128)
            fields = []
            for pair_index, pair in enumerate(raw_fields):
                sequence(pair, 2)
                if len(pair) != 2:
                    raise ValueError("event field pair")
                name_source, value_source = pair
                text(name_source, 65536)
                text(value_source, 65536)
                name = context.template(
                    name_source,
                    f"event/{event_index}/h/{pair_index}/n")
                value = context.template(
                    value_source,
                    f"event/{event_index}/h/{pair_index}/v")
                fields.append((name, value))
            field_pairs += len(raw_fields)
            events.append(EventSpec(at=at, kind="headers", stream=stream,
                                    fields=fields, end=end))
        else:
            source = text(record["data"], 65536)
            data = context.template(source, f"event/{event_index}/data")
            events.append(EventSpec(at=at, kind="data", stream=stream,
                                    data=data, end=end))

    raw_channels = sequence(document["channels"], 256)
    channels = []
    channel_names = set()
    part_budget = 0
    for channel_index, channel in enumerate(raw_channels):
        exact(channel, {"name", "parts"})
        name = text(channel["name"], 32)
        if NAME_RE.fullmatch(name) is None or name in channel_names:
            raise ValueError("channel name")
        channel_names.add(name)

        raw_parts = sequence(channel["parts"], 50000)
        part_budget += len(raw_parts)
        parts = []
        total_length = 0
        for part_index, part in enumerate(raw_parts):
            exact(part, {"case", "data"})
            owner = part["case"]
            if owner is not None:
                if type(owner) is not str or owner not in {c.name for c in cases}:
                    raise ValueError("owner label")
            source = text(part["data"], 65536)
            data = context.template(
                source, f"channel/{channel_index}/part/{part_index}/data")
            total_length += size(data)
            if total_length > MAX:
                raise ValueError("channel length")
            parts.append(PartSpec(owner=owner, data=data))
        channels.append(ChannelSpec(name=name, parts=parts))

    if frame_budget + len(raw_events) + part_budget > 50000:
        raise ValueError("combined budget")
    if field_pairs > 32768:
        raise ValueError("combined header budget")

    return DocumentSpec(seed=seed, timeout_ms=timeout_ms, cases=cases,
                        events=events, channels=channels, contexts=context)
